page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-360 is an enterprise-scale, memory-optimized instance based on the x86_64 architecture. The server is powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9B14 processors providing 180 physical cores and 360 virtual CPUs with simultaneous multithreading. It features an extensive 2880 GB RAM allocation, representing an 8 GB per vCPU ratio. Hardware acceleration flags include AVX-512 vector support (including VNNI and BF16) and cryptographic acceleration such as VAES and SHA-NI. The instance contains no bundled local NVMe storage and includes zero GPUs, necessitating external network-attached storage for persistent disk needs.

Benchmark testing demonstrates top-tier multi-threaded throughput and memory bandwidth. The instance achieved a stress-ng multi-core metric of 554,400.26 and a PassMark CPU score of 156,943.64, complemented by a large-block uncached memory read bandwidth of 709.69 GB/sec. In application benchmarks, it delivered 412.12 million operations per second in Redis SET workloads and scored 68,792.0 in Clang software compilation. CPU-based machine learning inference is also notable, generating 4,232.2 tokens per second in prompt processing on small 135M parameter models and 309.04 tokens per second on medium 7B parameter models.

From a cost-efficiency standpoint, the c3d-highmem-360 delivers massive resource consolidation within a single system image, reducing operational overhead associated with multi-node clusters. The primary trade-off is the absence of local NVMe disks, meaning high-I/O workloads will rely heavily on network storage interfaces. Additionally, the instance requires high sustained utilization of its 360 vCPUs and nearly 3 TB of memory to maximize return on resources.

This server type is engineered for heavy, memory-bound enterprise deployments. Key workload targets include large-scale in-memory databases, distributed caching layers such as Redis, enterprise enterprise resource planning platforms, large dataset analytical processing, and CPU-driven language model inference.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-360 is an ultra-dense, memory-optimized instance powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9B14 processors. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it delivers 180 physical cores, 360 vCPUs, and 2880 GB of system memory, yielding an 8 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio. The configuration features AVX-512 instruction support, zero discrete GPUs, and no integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes. Benchmark results place this machine in the top tier for multi-core computation, uncached memory bandwidth reaching 709.69 GB/sec, and high-frequency in-memory database execution, as evidenced by over 412 million Redis SET operations per second. While demanding disciplined resource saturation to remain cost-effective, its dense configuration removes clustering overhead for massive datasets. The c3d-highmem-360 is structured primarily for large in-memory databases, distributed caching systems, heavy multi-threaded software builds, and high-capacity CPU model inference.
